utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case number IT-00-39-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Krajisnik.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Madam Registrar. Mr. Harmon, I hope that you can address us again, you and your voice.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Yes, I can. Thank you very much, Your Honour. Good morning. I'm sorry for the inconvenience yesterday. I'm ready to proceed today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The first witness you call is a protected witness. I'm a bit confused about what pseudonym to use, but if you could --

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. If we -- the next witness is a witness whose testimony will proceed in closed session.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: I would suggest that he proceed on the pseudonym of BT21.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: BT21. Thank you, Mr. Harmon. If there's nothing else to be discussed at this moment, I'd like to turn into closed session. Mr. Stewart.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: Just a couple of things, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. STEWART
utterances.text: The -- there's just one, actually. And I'll say this in open session because I'll just say it very, very briefly. And if anything needs to be explored, it may have to be left to the closed session anyway. But, Your Honour, we inquire what the position is and what progress has been made and what inquiries have been completed in relation to the witness who was heard in closed session before. We have very much made the point that it's necessary for regular updates to be sought and given in relation to that matter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. I should have informed you yesterday. I'll do that in closed session. We received a first report. Thank you for reminding the Chamber. Then if that was it, then I'd like to turn into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 16th day of June, 2004, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.45 p.m.,
